The '''MS-1 ion cannon''' was a type of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] produced by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]]. 2,500 such cannons were installed aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]].
